    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-ASP.NET Core</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>上一篇文章给大家分享了</p>
<h1 class="postTitle"><span style="font-size: 15px"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" title="发布于 2026-03-01 10:12" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19629546">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-.NET CLI工具改进</a></span></h1>
<p>本篇文章接续给大家分享ASP.NET Core的一些增强：</p>
<p class="p1"><span style="font-size: 16px"><strong>一、Minimal API 内置参数验证（Built-in validation for Minimal APIs）</strong></span><span class="s1"><br></span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">在以前的版本中，<strong>Minimal API 默认不会自动执行 DataAnnotations 验证</strong><span class="s1">，通常需要：</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">手动调用 Validator</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">使用 FluentValidation</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">或写 Middleware / Filter</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;而在 <span class="s4"><strong>.NET 10</strong> 中，Minimal API <span class="s4"><strong>可以自动执行模型验证</strong>，和 MVC Controller 的行为一致。</span></span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><span class="s1">&nbsp;使用 <strong>DataAnnotations注解</strong><span class="s1">：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserDto
{
    [Required]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }

    [Range(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Age { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="p1">Minimal API：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>app.MapPost(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/users</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (UserDto dto) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Results.Ok(dto);
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="p1">如果请求：</p>
<p>{<br>  "age": 200<br>}</p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">系统会 <strong>自动返回 400</strong><span class="s1">：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">title</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">One or more validation errors occurred.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">errors</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The Name field is required.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">The field Age must be between 1 and 120.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个自动校验的触发机制是这样的</p>
<p class="p1">ASP.NET Core 会在 <span class="s1"><strong>Endpoint Binding 阶段</strong>执行：</span></p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="p1">Request Body → Model Binding</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">DataAnnotations Validation</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">如果失败 → 自动返回 400 ValidationProblem</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">如果成功 → 进入 Handler</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 16px">二、新增了对 Server-Sent Events（SSE）<span class="s1"> 的原生支持</span></span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">在 <a><span class="s1">ASP.NET Core</span></a> 的 <a><span class="s2"><strong>.NET 10</strong></span></a> 中，新增了对 <span class="s3"><strong>Server-Sent Events（SSE）</strong> 的原生支持，可以通过</span></p>
<p class="p2">TypedResults.ServerSentEvents<span class="s4"> 直接返回 <span class="s3"><strong>实时数据流</strong><span class="s4">。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="p1">这让 <span class="s3"><strong>Minimal API 实现实时推送变得非常简单</strong>，无需使用 WebSocket 或 SignalR。</span></p>
<p class="p1">一行代码搞定</p>
<p class="p1">TypedResults.ServerSentEvents()</p>
<p class="p1">自动：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">设置 Content-Type</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">处理数据流格式</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">处理 Flush</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;示例代码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>app.MapGet(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/time</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> IAsyncEnumerable&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetTimeStream()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yield</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> DateTime.Now.ToString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HH:mm:ss</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Task.Delay(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TypedResults.ServerSentEvents(GetTimeStream());
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>前端JS代码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<p>const source = new EventSource("/time");</p>
<p>source.onmessage = (event) =&gt; {<br>    console.log("Server time:", event.data);<br>};</p>
</div>
<p>同时，<span class="s1">.NET 10 支持 <strong>Typed SSE Event</strong><span class="s1">：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>app.MapGet("/events", () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    async IAsyncEnumerable</span>&lt;SseItem&lt;string&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stream()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            yield </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SseItem&lt;string&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
                DateTime.Now.ToString(),
                eventType: </span>"time"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            );

            await Task.Delay(</span>1000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TypedResults.ServerSentEvents(Stream());
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">三、OpenAPI 3.1支持</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><a>OpenAPI Specification</a><span class="s2"> 是 REST API 的行业标准规范。</span></span></p>
<p class="p1">OpenAPI 3.1 的核心变化：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/23525/202603/23525-20260315094159371-2013846924.png" alt="image" width="610" height="165" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;MiniAPI代码示例</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> builder =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.AddOpenApi();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> app =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> builder.Build();

app.MapGet(</span>"/stations", () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[]
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Id = 1, Name = "Station A"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> { Id = 2, Name = "Station B"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
    };
});

app.MapOpenApi();

app.Run();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>访问：/openapi/v1.json</p>
<p>返回<span class="s1">得到 <strong>OpenAPI 3.1</strong><span class="s1"> 文档。</span></span></p>
<p>同时YAML也得到了支持</p>
<p class="p1">在 API 管理和云平台中，很多工具更喜欢 <span class="s1"><strong>YAML</strong> 格式。</span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">/openapi/v1.yaml</span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">示例返回</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>openapi: 3.1.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
info:
  title: Charging API
  version: </span>1.0.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
paths:
  </span>/stations:
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    get:
      responses:
        </span>"200"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
          description: OK</span></pre>
</div>
<p>启用YAML输出</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>builder.Services.AddOpenApi(options =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    options.AddDocumentTransformer((doc, ctx, ct) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        doc.Info.Title </span>= "Charging Platform API"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Task.CompletedTask;
    });
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这个对于AI Function Call非常有用</p>
<p class="p1">现在很多 AI Agent 使用 OpenAPI 作为 <span class="s1"><strong>Tool Schema</strong>。</span></p>
<p class="p1"><strong>.NET 10 的 OpenAPI 3.1 + YAML 支持，使 ASP.NET Core API 在标准化、AI集成、API网关和DevOps场景下更加现代化。</strong></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1">以上分享给大家。</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1">周国庆</p>
